scope: Source-only approval plus fabricated-data fixtures; no real arrays, actual fits or held truth read. Root alone allocates frozen stages.
findings: All nine training months are explicit; January/July raw files are absent; April inputs are projected without target/BLOCK and April truth is decoded only after both models and predictions pass independent prescore audit.

Selection precedes train labels: fixed per-airport hash sample, all April input aliases purged without resampling, fixed canonical bank. Same-known-FLIGHT_ID, MVT_ID, HEX120s and known clock/stand/runway aliases are excluded.

37 source-blind fields preserve original definitions. Categories, median/IQR and uncapped target mean/std fit only retained training IDs. Global alias vocabulary is input-only metadata and never a predictive feature.

The two arms have identical model/init/optimizer/epochs/minibatches and dropout streams; only permitted donor label values differ. Label projection starts at zero. Saved full optimizer and terminal RNG permit independent post-fit parity checks.
Exact brute-force K16 stable ties follow globally sorted bank IDs; preflight fails rather than changing K if any training/query row lacks16 donors.
Every state is saved before reload and terminal-RNG diagnostic; completed stages have exclusive attempt markers and no automatic restart. Immutable shared allocation is required.

Independent prefit reconstructs raw populations, selection/purges,37features, all transformed inputs, training labels and all donor counts. Prescore reconstructs initial model hash and checks all state/optimizer/RNG/IDs/rounding without learned inference. Separate result auditor reconstructs raw April truth, SQL RMSE and paired-day bootstrap.
prospective_fixes_before_data: Explicit millisecond timestamps instead of dtype-dependent epoch conversion
Terminal optimizer/RNG saved, exact random-stream parity, checkpoint saved before parity diagnostic
limitations: April may have appeared in earlier studies; this is fresh-fit exclusion, not historically untouched validation.
Control is the same small input-only learned retrieval model; a pass does not establish gain over current v80 and only justifies separately frozen Jan/Jul validation.
Reuses exact pinned label-free physical bank; upstream sensor extraction is not rerun.
Runtime/memory remain estimates until actual preflight. A failure closes only this fixed small configuration; no parameter or seed sweep.

reciprocal_review.notes: Seven-column metadata, nullable features, optimizer/state schema and CPU initial hash checked; no blocker.
